title: Meh
text:
In theory this is probably a good idea but there are several flaws that caused me to cancel only 2 months in.
First is until the item ships, you can't see what it is. How can you plan to do something (like the garden kit) without knowing what is coming.
Second, I'm not sure they really know what stem is as the second (and final) product we recieved was a cars night light that the kids were supposed to paint one tiny part of it and that's it. Not to mention that with that product they inflated the price so much that it just wasnt worth it. I was so disappointed that we didnt bother waiting for the 3rd month's disappointing product. I could (and now do) find better things each month for my son to do with in the stem guidelines
label: negative
